title: AswitchI
description:
**AswitchI** by Lorapok Labs brings the fluid, intuitive experience of the macOS Launchpad and 3D Dock directly to Ubuntu, engineered exclusively for AI developer productivity.

It serves as a unified, central dashboard that automatically scans, organizes, and launches your entire AI engineering stack with zero friction:

* **Desktop AI IDEs:** One-click access to specialized environments like Cursor and Windsurf.
* **CLI AI Agents:** Instantly deploy terminal-based agents like Cline, Aider, and Antigravity.
* **Persistent Web AIs:** Run ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini in isolated, persistent web sessions without needing multiple browser tabs.

Powered by a lightweight WebKit2GTK architecture, AswitchI guarantees blazing-fast hardware acceleration, seamless context switching, and deep native Linux desktop integration.

Discover a cleaner way to build with AI.
Learn more: https://aswitchi.lorapok.tech
